items.title: 鴻海擬斥236億元取得三菱電機移動50%股權 共同經營汽車設備事業
items.title_en: Foxconn Plans to Spend NT$23.6 Billion to Acquire 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, Jointly Operate Automotive Equipment Business
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(16)日公告，透過旗下投資管理子公司利億國際投資，將與三菱電機株式會社正式簽訂策略聯盟協議，共同經營汽車設備事業；利億預計將以1150億日圓(約新台幣236億元)取得三菱電機移動株式會社(Mitsubishi Electric Mobility)50%股權，預計於2027年10月1日完成股權移轉交易。
根據合作協議，三菱電機將旗下負責汽車設備事業的三菱電機移動株式會社50%股權移轉予利億，未來雙方將共同經營三菱電機移動。根據股權移轉協議，標的事業的企業價值（Enterprise Value）為3,200億日圓，股權價值（Equity Value）為2,300億日圓，本次交易價格則依股權價值計算，對應移轉50%股權。
本次股權移轉仍須符合相關契約條件，包括取得競爭法及其他適用法令所要求的主管機關核准與許可。待相關條件均獲滿足後，預計於2027年10月1日完成股權移轉交易。
鴻海表示，透過此次共同經營，雙方將結合三菱電機移動的技術與研發實力，尤其是電子動力系統（electric powertrain）、軟體及車輛控制等領域的優勢，以及鴻海在執行速度、規模化發展與市場落地方面的能力，共同打造源自日本的高品質電動車平台（基礎架構），推動次世代移動解決方案的普及與發展。
此次策略聯盟將結合日本製造業長期累積的先進技術與品質優勢，為次世代移動領域創造新的價值，進一步強化日本國內產業基礎，並支持汽車產業永續成長。展望中長期，雙方將致力於將日本的技術與品質推向全球市場，進一步提升「Made in/by Japan」的價值，並向全球展現日本製造業的發展潛力。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today, October 16, that through its investment‑management subsidiary Li‑Yi International Investment it will sign a strategic alliance agreement with Mitsubishi Electric Corp. to jointly operate the automotive equipment business. Li‑Yi intends to purchase a 50% stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility for ¥1.15 trillion (about NT$23.6 billion), with the share‑transfer expected to be completed on October 1, 2027.

Under the cooperation agreement, Mitsubishi Electric will transfer its 50% ownership of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, the unit responsible for automotive equipment, to Li‑Yi. The two parties will thereafter co‑manage Mitsubishi Electric Mobility. The enterprise value of the target business is ¥320 billion, the equity value ¥230 billion, and the transaction price is based on the equity value for the 50% share being transferred.

The share transfer remains subject to meeting contractual conditions, including obtaining approvals and permits required by competition law and other applicable regulations. Once all conditions are satisfied, the transfer is slated to close on October 1, 2027.

Foxconn said that through this joint operation the parties will combine Mitsubishi Electric Mobility’s technology and R&D strengths—particularly in electric powertrains, software and vehicle control—with Foxconn’s speed of execution, scale‑up capability and market rollout expertise to build a high‑quality electric‑vehicle platform rooted in Japan and promote the adoption and development of next‑generation mobility solutions.

The strategic alliance will fuse Japan’s long‑standing advanced manufacturing technology and quality advantage to create new value in next‑generation mobility, further strengthening the domestic industrial base and supporting sustainable growth of the automotive sector. Over the medium to long term, both sides aim to bring Japanese technology and quality to global markets, enhancing the value of “Made in/by Japan” and showcasing the development potential of Japanese manufacturing worldwide.

items.title: 經濟部擬赴德州設立AI產業園區 童子賢：可借鏡廣達Q-Bus模式
items.title_en: MOEA Plans to Set Up AI Industry Park in Texas, Tong Tzu-Hsien: Can Model After Quanta’s Q‑Bus Approach
paras: 經濟部將赴美國德州設立AI產業園區，和碩(4938-TW)董事長童子賢今(16)日出席東元70週年論壇，被問及此事，指出可借鏡廣達(2382-TW)過去到上海松江打造的「Q-Bus」模式「向巴士一般，整個打包運過去」，將有助中小企業於當地快速落地，並形成產業鏈。
經濟部計畫於美國德州設立AI產業園區，投資成本最高達40億美元，並由經濟部與電電公會共同推動。
對此，童子賢表示，大型企業如台積電(2330-TW)赴亞利桑那州設廠，從基礎設施、員工居住等都可以「自己包」，不過像是無塵衣清洗、特用材料及小型零件加工品等作業再回到台灣執行，恐怕影響效率，因此仍需完整的產業聚落支持。
童子賢進一步指出，政府要到德州設立產業園區，可比照廣達於上海松江的Q-Bus模式，讓缺乏國際經驗的供應商可快速落地。他並指出，倘若從營建施工、員工食宿、醫療、子女教育，到向當地政府申請水電執照以及廢水廢棄物處理等程序都要自行摸索，直言「這樣效率很低」。
童子賢也提到，台灣在科學園區管理已累積成熟及豐富經驗，並以和碩在越南海防的經驗為例，當地有比利時開發商統包填海造陸、廢水處理、發電及海水淡化，企業可申請服務並支付費用，進駐後便可運作，有助提高營運效率。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs will go to Texas, USA to establish an AI industry park, and Hon Hai Precision Industry (4938‑TW) chairman Tong Tzu‑Hsien attended the TECO 70th anniversary forum today (the 16th). When asked about the plan, he said that they can learn from Quanta Computer’s (2382‑TW) past “Q‑Bus” model built in Songjiang, Shanghai – essentially “packaged like a bus and shipped over” – which will help small and medium‑sized enterprises settle quickly on site and form a supply chain.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to set up an AI industry park in Texas, with a maximum investment of up to US$4 billion, and the project will be promoted jointly by the ministry and the Electrical and Electronics Manufacturers’ Association.

Tong said that large firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW) building factories in Arizona can “bundle” everything from basic infrastructure to employee housing themselves. However, operations such as clean‑room garment cleaning, special‑material processing, and small‑component machining that would have to be done back in Taiwan could hurt efficiency, so a complete industrial ecosystem is still needed.

He added that the government should follow Quanta’s Q‑Bus model in Songjiang, allowing suppliers with little international experience to set up quickly in Texas. He warned that if companies have to figure out everything on their own—from construction, employee lodging, medical care, children’s education, to applying for local water‑electricity permits and waste‑water treatment—the efficiency would be very low.

Tong also noted that Taiwan has accumulated mature and rich experience in managing science parks, citing Hon Hai’s experience in Haiphong, Vietnam. There, a Belgian developer handled land‑reclamation, wastewater treatment, power generation and seawater desalination under a turnkey contract; companies can simply apply for the services and pay fees, allowing them to operate immediately after moving in, which improves operational efficiency.

items.title: AI交易「最佳階段」已過？巴克萊：晶片股暴跌是部位出清而非基本面崩塌
items.title_en: Has the "Prime Phase" of AI Trading Passed? Barclays: Chip Stock Crash Is Position Clearing, Not Fundamental Collapse
paras: 巴克萊策略師 Emmanuel Cau 表示，美國通膨數據居高不下、中東緊張局勢再度升溫，以及晶片股遭到拋售，正考驗該行對股市仍有望沿著「狹窄的上漲路徑」走高的判斷。
根據《Investing.com》報導，Cau在研究報告中表示，本週市場出現多項不利因素。美國消費者物價指數（CPI）與生產者物價指數（PPI）高於預期，重新引發市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的疑慮；中東局勢再度升溫，推動布蘭特原油價格攀上新高；晶片股則遭遇大幅拋售。
此外，第三季財報季開局表現參差不齊，美國銀行股尤其疲弱，已進入修正區間。他直言：「可以說，本週的事態發展相當不利。」
不過，Cau認為，債券殖利率終於回落，為市場帶來一線希望，顯示債券可能再次發揮避險資產的作用。
他也提醒，考慮到AI 交易與殖利率上升彼此密切相關，「同時擔心 AI 交易與殖利率上升並不合理」，並提醒投資人「應謹慎看待自己所期待的結果」。
本週科技股與半導體類股承受最大賣壓，費城半導體指數(SOX) 與南韓綜合指數(KOSPI) 分別下跌約8%及14%。
Cau指出，除了通膨數據帶來的衝擊，晶片股走弱還受到三項因素影響。
首先，全球記憶體市場競爭日益激烈，對南韓股市造成最明顯的衝擊。其次，亞洲兩家資料中心企業延後首次公開募股（IPO），重新引發市場對相關產業融資能力及估值的疑慮。第三，投資人持續檢視企業投入AI的龐大資本支出，究竟能否轉化為實質營收。
不過， Cau對記憶體市場競爭問題的擔憂相對有限，並認為另外兩項因素也不是全新的風險。
他指出，產業基本面依然穩健，艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 與台積電(2330-TW) 近期公布的業績均提供了強勁的需求展望。
他認為，近期市場走弱，很大程度上反映的是「投資人持倉布局，而非基本面出現實質性惡化」，投資人只要看到這類負面消息，就很容易迅速採取獲利了結行動。
儘管如此，Cau 表示，AI 題材正進入「更成熟的階段」，市場將更加嚴格檢視企業估值、融資需求、競爭威脅、監管環境及營收能見度。
他坦言，AI題材交易表現最好的階段可能已經過去，投資人應採取更具選擇性的布局策略，優先考慮商業模式經過驗證、現金流強勁、營收來源明確且估值合理的企業。
在產業配置方面，巴克萊持續主張採取較為均衡的策略。該行上個月已增加電信等低貝塔（low-beta）值類股的配置，並相對減碼原物料類股。
不過，Cau 表示，大型科技公司的基本面「整體而言仍具支撐」，而財報季還有很大一部分尚未展開，因此「現階段明智的做法，是先保持觀望，不要因局部問題而全盤否定」。
他指出，未來幾週大型科技股的財報將是關鍵；此外，巴克萊仍將歐洲市場視為分散投資風險的有效選項，因為歐洲市場對 AI 題材的曝險較低，半導體產業的集中度也相對較低。
paras_en: Barclays strategist Emmanuel Cau said that persistently high US inflation data, renewed Middle East tensions, and a sell‑off in chip stocks are testing the bank’s view that the equity market can still climb along a "narrow upward path."

According to Investing.com, Cau wrote in his research note that several adverse factors hit the market this week. US Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) came in above expectations, reviving concerns that monetary policy may tighten further; renewed Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude to fresh highs; and chip stocks suffered a sharp sell‑off.

In addition, the start of Q3 earnings season has been uneven, with US bank stocks especially weak and now entering a correction zone. He bluntly said, "You could say this week’s developments have been quite unfavorable."
However, Cau believes that bond yields finally falling gives the market a glimmer of hope, indicating that bonds may once again serve as a safe‑haven asset.

He also warned that, given the close link between AI trading and rising yields, "it’s unreasonable to worry about AI trading and higher yields at the same time," and cautioned investors to "carefully consider the outcomes they expect."
This week technology and semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of selling pressure, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) and South Korea’s KOSPI falling about 8% and 14% respectively.
Cau pointed out that, beyond the impact of inflation data, the weakness in chip stocks is driven by three factors.

First, competition in the global memory market is intensifying, hitting South Korean equities hardest. Second, two Asian data‑center companies delayed their initial public offerings, reigniting doubts about financing capacity and valuations in the sector. Third, investors continue to scrutinise the massive capital expenditures companies are making on AI to see whether they can translate into real revenue.
Nevertheless, Cau’s concern about memory‑market competition is relatively limited, and he sees the other two factors as not entirely new risks.
He noted that industry fundamentals remain solid, with recent earnings from ASML (ASML‑US) and TSMC (2330‑TW) offering a strong demand outlook.

He believes the recent market weakness largely reflects "investor position‑taking rather than a substantive deterioration in fundamentals," and that investors tend to quickly book profits when faced with such negative news.

That said, Cau said AI themes are entering a "more mature stage," and the market will scrutinise corporate valuations, financing needs, competitive threats, regulatory environment and revenue visibility more rigorously.

He admitted that the best‑performing phase for AI‑themed trading may be behind us, and investors should adopt a more selective positioning strategy, favouring companies with proven business models, strong cash flow, clear revenue sources and reasonable valuations.

In terms of sector allocation, Barclays continues to advocate a relatively balanced approach. The bank increased exposure to low‑beta stocks such as telecoms last month while trimming exposure to raw‑material sectors.

However, Cau said the fundamentals of large‑cap tech firms "overall still have support," and a sizable portion of the earnings season is yet to unfold, so "the prudent move now is to stay on the sidelines and not dismiss the whole market because of localized issues."

He added that upcoming earnings from large‑cap tech stocks will be pivotal in the coming weeks; moreover, Barclays still views the European market as an effective diversification option because it has lower AI exposure and a less concentrated semiconductor industry.

items.title: 「大賣空」貝瑞加碼做空美股！押注那斯達克與半導體股回檔
items.title_en: ‘Big Short’ Michael Burry Increases US Stock Short Bets, Betting on a Pullback in the Nasdaq and Semiconductor Stocks
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，優秀的科技與便宜的價格很少會同時出現，AI就是最明顯例子。Bain & Company 估計，到2031年，AI產業每年需要創造6兆美元的營收，才能合理支撐目前的資料中心支出，但當今產品最多只能貢獻其中1.8兆美元。剩餘4.2兆美元，必須來自目前幾乎尚不存在的企業與商業模式。若無法達成這個目標，AI資料中心可能面臨重大崩潰風險。
很少有人像貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 一樣，大聲質疑這項落差。他因在全球金融危機前準確預測美國房市崩盤而聲名大噪。
他在9月加碼放空美光 (MU-US)、Nebius、Palantir (PLTR-US)，以及一檔半導體ETF，理由是記憶體晶片短缺的情況終將消退。
如今，他已重新調整整體押注策略。
10月11日，貝瑞在 Substack 上告訴讀者，他已將大部分選擇權部位轉換為兩項指數放空交易：買進那斯達克100指數的賣權，以及 VanEck 半導體ETF (SMH-US) 賣權。他也表示，預期未來9個月內市場將出現一個重要高點，並警告這波漲勢的最後階段可能會劇烈震盪。
他的選擇權合約細節相當明確：那斯達克100指數賣權於2027年4月到期，SMH賣權則於2027年6月到期。兩者履約價都比標的目前價格低約20%。
貝瑞認為，由於目前市場波動率偏低，那斯達克100指數賣權的價格相對便宜。他預期，即使指數或ETF尚未真正下跌20%，這兩項部位的價值也可能大幅增加。
市場廣度的變化，為他的論點提供了一些支持。那斯達克100指數於9月22日收在30,732點的歷史新高，但自8月中旬以來，成分股中股價高於200日移動平均線的比例，已從77%降至56%。意味著推動這波漲勢的股票正在減少。
貝瑞並未完全放棄其他放空交易。他仍持有甲骨文 (ORCL-US)、Palantir、MetLife (MET-US) 及開拓重工 (CAT-US) 的賣權，作為輔助押注。
他將 SMH 視為一項高度集中的押注，因為這檔ETF重押當前最熱門、股價漲幅也最驚人的晶片股。輝達 (NVDA-US) 占該ETF 19.6%，台積電 (TSM-US) 占9.3%，超微 (AMD-US) 占5.6%。博通 (AVGO-US)、美光、邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) 及應用材料 (AMAT-US) 權重則各接近5%。
這檔ETF之所以引起布瑞注意，原因並不難理解。SMH今年以來已上漲超過67%。
不過，股價大幅上漲本身，並不能證明市場已形成泡沫。
假設ETF成分股公司的獲利同期翻倍，即使股價上漲67%，但獲利成長100%，基金的本益比反而會低於年初水準。因此，貝瑞需要提出更多證據，而不能只憑一張持續上漲的股價走勢圖，就認定市場存在泡沫。
他的論點主要聚焦於支出。貝瑞認為，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Meta (META-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 及甲骨文承擔了龐大的表外承諾，而市場尚未充分將這些風險反映在股價中。不過，雲端業務上季仍維持強勁成長，市場也預期明年的資本支出將突破1兆美元。因此，看多與看空的投資人其實正在觀察相同的數據，只是對其意義有不同解讀。
貝瑞也將矛頭指向供應商本身。他將輝達比作思科 (Cisco)，並指出客戶過度集中的風險，因為大型雲端服務商約占輝達資料中心營收的一半。
即使是貝瑞的放空交易，也可能暫時無法奏效。截至9月底，美光股價仍比他最初放空時約1,051美元的價格高出約2%，代表這筆交易當時仍處於小幅虧損狀態。而且有49位分析師將美光評為「強力買進」。
投資人不必照抄貝瑞的交易，也能從中得到啟示：檢視自己的投資組合，有多少資產集中在少數幾檔AI熱門股上。
半導體ETF與那斯達克指數ETF，往往持有許多相同的大型科技股，因此兩者之間的持股重疊程度，可能比表面上看起來更高。
這些股票的高估值能否持續，取決於營收成長能否追上龐大的支出。按照 Bain & Company 估算，AI產業每年仍須額外創造4.2兆美元的營收，才能填補目前的缺口。
貝瑞依然看空市場。這次將部位整合後，他的看空立場更加清晰，但外界仍無法從中判斷他實際押注的規模。建立正確的交易結構是一回事，準確掌握進場與獲利時機，則是另一項完全不同的挑戰。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that excellent technology and cheap prices rarely appear together, and AI is the clearest example. Bain & Company estimates that by 2031 the AI industry will need to generate $6 trillion in annual revenue to reasonably support current data‑center spending, yet today’s products can contribute at most $1.8 trillion. The remaining $4.2 trillion must come from companies and business models that virtually do not exist yet. If that target is not met, AI data centers could face a major collapse risk.
Few people have questioned this gap as loudly as Michael Burry, who rose to fame for accurately predicting the US housing market collapse before the global financial crisis.
In September he added to his short positions in Micron Technology (MU‑US), Nebius, Palantir (PLTR‑US) and a semiconductor ETF, arguing that the memory‑chip shortage will eventually dissipate.
He has now readjusted his overall betting strategy.

On October 11 Burry told readers on Substack that he had converted most of his options positions into two index‑short trades: buying put options on the Nasdaq‑100 index and put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US). He also said he expects a major market high within the next nine months and warned that the final stage of this rally could see violent volatility.
The details of his options contracts are clear: the Nasdaq‑100 put expires in April 2027 and the SMH put expires in June 2027. Both have strike prices about 20 % below the current market levels.

Burry believes that, because market volatility is currently low, the Nasdaq‑100 puts are relatively cheap. He expects that even if the index or the ETF does not yet fall the full 20 %, the value of these two positions could rise sharply.

Changes in market breadth lend some support to his view. The Nasdaq‑100 closed at a record 30,732 on September 22, but since mid‑August the proportion of constituents trading above their 200‑day moving average has fallen from 77 % to 56 %, indicating that fewer stocks are driving the rally.
Burry has not abandoned all short trades. He still holds put options on Oracle (ORCL‑US), Palantir, MetLife (MET‑US) and Caterpillar (CAT‑US) as supplemental bets.

He treats SMH as a highly concentrated bet because the ETF is heavily weighted toward the hottest and fastest‑rising chip stocks. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) makes up 19.6 % of the fund, TSMC (TSM‑US) 9.3 %, AMD (AMD‑US) 5.6 %, while Broadcom (AVGO‑US), Micron, Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) each sit near 5 %.
The ETF has drawn Burry’s attention for a simple reason: SMH is up more than 67 % year‑to‑date.
However, a sharp price rise alone does not prove a bubble has formed.

If the earnings of the ETF’s component companies double in the same period, a 67 % price increase would actually lower the fund’s price‑to‑earnings ratio below its early‑year level. Therefore Burry needs more evidence than a continuously rising price chart to claim a bubble.

His argument focuses mainly on spending. Burry says Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle carry massive off‑balance‑sheet commitments that the market has not fully priced in. Yet cloud revenue remains strong this quarter, and the market expects next year’s cap‑ex to break $1 trillion. Thus bullish and bearish investors are looking at the same data, but interpreting it differently.

Burry also points the finger at the suppliers themselves. He likens Nvidia to Cisco, highlighting the risk of customer concentration because large cloud providers account for roughly half of Nvidia’s data‑center revenue.

Even Burry’s short trades may not work immediately. As of the end of September Micron’s share price was still about 2 % above the roughly $1,051 level when he first shorted it, meaning the trade was still slightly in loss. Moreover, 49 analysts rate Micron as a “strong buy.”
Investors don’t have to copy Burry’s trades to learn from them: they should review their own portfolios to see how much exposure they have to a handful of hot AI stocks.
Semiconductor ETFs and Nasdaq‑based ETFs often hold many of the same large‑cap tech stocks, so the overlap between them may be higher than it appears on the surface.

Whether these stocks’ lofty valuations can persist depends on whether revenue growth can keep pace with massive spending. According to Bain & Company, the AI industry still needs to generate an additional $4.2 trillion in annual revenue to close the current gap.

Burry remains bearish on the market. After consolidating his positions, his short stance is clearer, but outsiders still cannot gauge the actual size of his bet. Building a sound trade structure is one thing; timing entry and exit accurately is an entirely different challenge.

items.title: 兩岸收緊科技管制！中國擬管制AI等40項技術出口 台灣嚴堵晶片走私
items.title_en: Cross-Strait Tightening of Tech Controls! China Plans to Regulate Export of AI and 40 Other Technologies, Taiwan Cracks Down on Chip Smuggling
paras: 全球 AI 競爭延伸至出口管制。多家週五 (16 日) 報導，中國擬限制部分關鍵技術向海外轉移，但保留多數 AI 應用服務的海外市場空間；台灣則準備收緊 AI 伺服器與先進半導體出口管制，防堵受限制硬體違規流入中國。
兩項政策管制的對象與流向不同。中國著重管理本國技術輸出，涉及 AI、生物醫藥及太陽能三大領域；台灣則著重硬體出口，擬透過擴大管制清單與強化刑責，進一步配合美國對中國的科技出口限制。
中國擬新增 40 項技術 AI 占逾半
中國商務部與科技部週五公布《中國禁止出口限制出口技術目錄》修訂徵求意見稿，擬新增 40 項技術，其中 14 項禁止出口、26 項限制出口。目前仍在公開徵求意見，最終清單尚未定案。
新增項目中，AI 領域占 23 項，涵蓋大型模型、AI 代理、運算叢集及資訊處理；太陽能領域占 12 項，涉及多晶矽、矽晶圓與太陽能電池製造；生物醫藥領域則占 5 項，包括細胞與基因治療、小核酸藥物及病原微生物相關技術。
其中，AI 驅動的惡意程式碼生成與變異技術，以及鈣鈦礦與疊層太陽能電池模組生產技術等，擬列入禁止出口項目；AI 輔助漏洞挖掘技術則擬列為限制出口項目。
中國商務部表示，部分 AI 技術可能被用於攻擊關鍵基礎設施、國防及政府系統，因此有必要防範技術失控與濫用。官方並強調，此次修訂屬於例行技術貿易管理，不針對特定國家、地區或實體。
管制關鍵在技術轉移 多數 AI 服務仍可拓展海外市場
不過，將部分 AI 技術納入清單，並不代表全面限制中國模型與應用產品進軍海外。商務部表示，判斷是否適用管制的核心，在於是否涉及受限制技術由中國境內向境外轉移。
例如，受限制大型模型若在海外進行在地部署，便屬於技術出口管理範圍；但企業利用這些模型，對外提供 API 呼叫、App、網頁互動或軟體即服務 (SaaS) 等應用，則不屬於大型模型技術出口管理範圍。
對已透過開源或發表學術論文等方式進入公共領域的技術，也不納入管理。至於涉及 AI 技術開源、企業赴海外自建自營運算中心、赴境外進行晶片試產製造及聯合研發等技術出口情形，則可適用自動許可等便利措施。
這套安排反映中國試圖在技術安全與海外商業拓展之間取得平衡。商務部強調，措施正式實施後，絕大多數 AI 技術仍可自由出口。
清單尚未定案 相關出口先辦登記
儘管正式管制內容仍待確定，中國已先啟動登記要求。自 10 月 16 日起至修訂目錄正式公告實施前，業者出口公告所列技術，須先透過商務部指定平台辦理登記。
適用情形包括向境外轉移技術所有權、授權境外使用境內技術，以及境內技術所有權人或實際控制人變更為境外主體等。公告所列太陽能關鍵與核心設備出口，也須依規定登記。
台灣從硬體流向著手 擬強化違規輸中刑責
相較於中國管理本國技術輸出，台灣此次政策重點在於管控 AI 硬體流向，防堵受限制產品經由走私管道進入中國。
經濟部長龔明鑫接受《彭博》專訪時表示，台灣擬將 AI 伺服器與先進半導體納入出口管制清單。新措施上路後，違規向中國運送受管制品項，將依《貿易法》追究刑事責任，但他未透露實施時程。
龔明鑫指出，台灣已在今年簽署的《台美對等貿易協定》(ART) 中作出相當程度的承諾，因此未來針對管制品項的部分措施，將與美國保持一致。
美國長期限制輝達 (NVDA-US) 等業者的先進 AI 晶片及高階半導體製造設備出口至中國，但相關產品仍持續透過走私管道流入當地。台灣擬擴大管制並強化刑責，目的正是加強阻堵這類違規輸送。
paras_en: Global AI competition is extending into export controls. Multiple reports on Friday (the 16th) said China intends to restrict the overseas transfer of certain key technologies while preserving most AI application services’ access to foreign markets; Taiwan is preparing to tighten export controls on AI servers and advanced semiconductors to prevent restricted hardware from illegally flowing into China.

The two policy controls target different subjects and flows. China focuses on managing its own technology exports, covering AI, biomedicine and solar energy; Taiwan focuses on hardware exports, planning to expand the control list and strengthen criminal penalties to further align with the United States’ technology export restrictions on China.
China plans to add 40 technologies, with AI accounting for more than half

China’s Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology on Friday released a draft for public comment on the revised “Catalogue of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export.” The draft proposes adding 40 technologies, of which 14 would be prohibited from export and 26 would be restricted. The list is still open for comment and has not been finalized.

Among the new items, AI accounts for 23 entries, covering large‑scale models, AI agents, computing clusters and information processing; solar energy accounts for 12 entries, involving polysilicon, silicon wafers and solar cell manufacturing; biomedicine accounts for 5 entries, including cell and gene therapies, small‑molecule nucleic‑acid drugs and pathogen‑related technologies.

Specifically, AI‑driven malicious code generation and mutation techniques, as well as perovskite and tandem solar‑cell module production technologies, are slated to be prohibited from export; AI‑assisted vulnerability‑discovery tools are proposed to be placed under export restrictions.

The Ministry of Commerce said some AI technologies could be used to attack critical infrastructure, defense and government systems, so it is necessary to guard against loss of control and misuse. Officials stressed that the revision is routine technology‑trade management and is not targeted at any particular country, region or entity.
Control hinges on technology transfer; most AI services can still expand overseas markets

However, placing certain AI technologies on the list does not mean a blanket ban on Chinese models and applications abroad. The Ministry said the key test for applicability is whether a restricted technology is transferred from within China to abroad.

For example, a restricted large‑scale model that is deployed locally overseas would fall under technology‑export management; but if a company uses that model to provide API calls, apps, web interactions or software‑as‑a‑service (SaaS) to customers, that is not considered export of the large‑model technology.

Technologies that have entered the public domain through open‑source releases or academic papers are also excluded from control. Situations involving open‑source AI, companies building and operating overseas computing centers, overseas chip pilot production, or joint R&D can qualify for automatic licensing and other facilitation measures.

This arrangement reflects China’s attempt to balance technology security with overseas commercial expansion. The Ministry emphasized that once the measures are formally implemented, the vast majority of AI technologies will still be freely exportable.
List not yet finalized; related exports must be registered first

Although the final regulatory content is still pending, China has already launched a registration requirement. From October 16 until the revised catalogue is officially announced, exporters of the listed technologies must register through a platform designated by the Ministry of Commerce.

Applicable cases include transferring technology ownership abroad, licensing foreign parties to use domestic technology, and changes in ownership or control of domestic technology to foreign entities. Exports of key solar equipment listed in the announcement must also be registered as required.
Taiwan tackles hardware flows, plans to strengthen penalties for illegal shipments to China

Compared with China’s focus on managing its own technology exports, Taiwan’s policy centers on controlling the flow of AI hardware to block restricted products from entering China via smuggling channels.

In an interview with Bloomberg, Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑xin said Taiwan intends to place AI servers and advanced semiconductors on the export‑control list. After the new measures take effect, illegal shipments of controlled items to China will be prosecuted under the Trade Act, though he did not disclose the implementation timeline.

Gong noted that Taiwan has already made substantial commitments in the Taiwan‑U.S. Reciprocal Trade Agreement (ART) signed this year, so future measures on controlled items will be aligned with the United States.

The United States has long restricted exports of advanced AI chips and high‑end semiconductor manufacturing equipment from companies such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) to China, yet those products continue to reach the market via smuggling. Taiwan plans to broaden controls and tighten penalties specifically to block such illicit transfers.

items.title: AI股殺聲隆隆！恐慌指數VIX衝破22 大額買權押注11月波動延續
items.title_en: AI Stock Slump Roars! Panic Index VIX Breaks 22, Large Call Options Bet on Continued November Volatility
paras: 《CNBC》週五 (16 日) 報導，人工智慧 (AI) 相關股票遭遇賣壓，推升有「華爾街恐慌指數」之稱的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數 (VIX)，4 個月來首度突破 22。多筆大額買權交易顯示，部分交易員正為市場波動延續至 11 月預作準備。
報導指出，一名交易員斥資約 170 萬美元，買進 9,200 口於 11 月 18 日到期、履約價為 20 的 VIX 買權，另投入約 110 萬美元，買進同日到期、履約價為 23 的 12,500 口買權，合計投入約 280 萬美元。
這類部位可用於押注波動率上升，也可能是投資組合的避險安排，反映部分市場參與者正防範 11 月中旬前後的股市下行風險。
SpotGamma 創辦人 Brent Kochuba 表示，VIX 當天快速攀升，加上相關選擇權成交量放大，顯示交易員正將 10 月的 VIX 部位獲利了結，並轉向較長天期部位，以因應可能出現的更大幅市場跌勢。
他也觀察到，11 月 VIX 買權出現數筆金額超過 100 萬美元的交易。
從交易分布來看，週五買進交易最活躍的 10 檔 VIX 選擇權合約中，有 9 檔是買權，其中 6 檔的履約價，高於 VIX 當天最初急升後回落的水準。這 9 檔合約的權利金成交總額接近 2,700 萬美元，約占當天 VIX 選擇權權利金總成交額的 36%。
科技股方面，AI 產業疑慮升溫，加上市場對新型雲端服務商 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 的擔憂，拖累那指收跌超 2%，費半指數大跌近4%，CoreWeave 股價則慘崩逾 11%。
市場下週將迎來另一項考驗，特斯拉 (TSLA-US)、SpaceX 與 Meta (META-US) 將陸續公布財報。在 AI 相關股票承壓之際，企業業績與展望能否穩定投資人信心，將成為觀察市場波動能否降溫的焦點。
paras_en: CNBC reported on Friday the 16th that AI‑related stocks faced selling pressure, pushing the Chicago Board Options Exchange’s volatility index (VIX)—often called the Wall Street panic gauge—to break above 22 for the first time in four months. Several large call‑option trades indicate that some traders are positioning for market volatility to persist into November.

The report noted that one trader spent about $1.7 million to buy 9,200 VIX call contracts expiring on November 18 with a strike of 20, and another roughly $1.1 million for 12,500 calls expiring the same day with a strike of 23, for a total outlay of about $2.8 million.
Such positions can be used to bet on rising volatility or as a hedge for portfolios, reflecting that some market participants are guarding against a stock‑market downside around mid‑November.

Brent Kochuba, founder of SpotGamma, said the VIX surged quickly that day and option volume expanded, showing traders were taking profits on October VIX positions and shifting to longer‑dated contracts to brace for a potentially larger market drop.
He also observed that several November VIX call trades exceeded $1 million each.

Looking at the trade distribution, nine of the ten most actively bought VIX option contracts on Friday were calls, and six of those had strikes above the level to which the VIX retreated after its initial spike. The premium traded on those nine contracts totaled nearly $27 million, about 36% of the day’s total VIX option premium volume.

In tech stocks, growing concerns about the AI sector and worries about new cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) pulled the Nasdaq down more than 2%, the semiconductor index fell almost 4%, and CoreWeave’s share price collapsed by over 11%.

The market faces another test next week as Tesla (TSLA‑US), SpaceX and Meta (META‑US) are set to release earnings. With AI‑related stocks under pressure, whether corporate results and outlooks can steady investor confidence will be key to seeing if market volatility cools.

items.title: AI資本開支藏「租賃帳單」！大摩估2027年投資規模達1.58兆美元
items.title_en: AI Capital Spending Hides a "Leasing Bill"! Morgan Stanley Estimates 2027 Investment Scale at $1.58 Trillion
paras: 當傳統資本開支口徑不再完整，租賃融資正悄然重塑AI基礎設施投資的全貌。據摩根士丹利Nicholas Lentini團隊最新研究報告，將租賃資本開支納入統計後，超大規模雲端服務商（hyperscaler）及新興雲端服務商（neocloud）2027年AI運算投資總規模升至約1.58兆美元，較現金資本開支口徑擴大約14%。這數字意味著2026年至2027年間，AI投資增量高達約7,000億美元，增速約60%。
摩根士丹利指出，這1.58兆美元的資本開支將直接帶動標普500指數約5%的2027年營收，並貢獻約25%的營收增速。更廣泛來看，被摩根士丹利歸類為AI核心受益者的「使能者」（Enablers）與「採用者」（Adopters）合計將驅動標普500指數78%的2027年獲利成長。值得注意的是，輝達一家公司預計將獨占標普500指數AI資本開支流入規模的約三分之二。
研究顯示，超大規模雲端服務商已披露逾1.1兆美元尚未啟動的租賃承諾。由於資料中心租賃屬於債務融資性質的資產購置，在現金流量表中不會列為資本開支，也不納入管理層指引，導致市場長期低估AI實際投資規模。將租賃項目納入後，摩根士丹利估計2026年、2027年、2028年AI總資本開支分別約為9,800億美元、1.58兆美元及1.81兆美元，年增率分別約為100%、60%及14%。
摩根士丹利在本次報告中首次系統性引入超大規模雲端服務商的租賃資本開支預測。根據其估算，2027年租賃資本開支達1,950億美元，2028年進一步擴大至2,460億美元。從單家公司來看，2027年甲骨文貢獻最大，達572億美元，其次依序為微軟（453億美元）、Meta（372億美元）、亞馬遜（284億美元）及Google（266億美元）。
此問題核心在於會計處理方式。超大規模雲端服務商透過租賃方式取得資料中心，在經濟實質上等同於以債務融資購置資產，但並不列入現金流量表的資本開支項目，也不納入管理層的資本開支指引。摩根士丹利認為，這導致傳統資本開支預測「越來越難以還原資本投入的全貌」。
從投資回報角度來看，摩根士丹利對這批投資持樂觀態度。報告估計，新增運算容量的投資資本報酬率（ROIC）介於25%至50%之間，並評估GPU租賃（IaaS）及模型API兩類業務模式：前者可實現60%至70%的邊際EBIT利潤率及25%至40%的ROIC；後者的增量EBIT利潤率可超過70%，ROIC最高可達63%。
摩根士丹利透過由下而上的方式，將1.58兆美元資本開支追蹤至約50家公司的營收，涵蓋科技、通信服務、工業、能源及海外ODM等板塊。按其測算，約65%的AI資本開支最終流入標普500成分股的營收，其中輝達占據流入規模的約三分之二。
在各受益板塊中，AI晶片、記憶體、網路設備及ODM（原始設計製造商）獲得最大市佔，輝達、三星、SK hynix及美光合計拿走其中絕大部分。
晶片層面，摩根士丹利認為輝達具備最佳風險報酬比，理由是公司正處於新一代產品週期成長的早期階段，Feynman平台有望推動每GW算力對應的營收超過500億美元，且目前估值約為2028會計年度預估每股盈餘（FY28 EPS）的15倍，具備估值擴張空間。博通亦受益於客製化晶片業務擴張，預計2028年XPU市場規模將突破1兆美元。

記憶體層面，DRAM已成為AI建設的關鍵瓶頸，但相關股票僅以約3倍未來12個月（NTM）本益比交易，隱含的成長溢價幾乎為零。摩根士丹利判斷，記憶體週期將於2026年第四季進入後期，價格漲幅趨於溫和，供給增加將限制獲利超出預期的空間。SK hynix與Samsung已透過長期協議（LTA）鎖定大部分需求；SK hynix承諾回購並註銷400億韓元股份，Samsung則設定2026年900億至1,100億韓元的股東回報目標。
網路設備層面，每增加1美元的超大規模雲端服務商資本開支，約對應0.25美元的網路設備營收，預計2027年網路設備總營收約為3,740億美元。在涵蓋的主要公司中，輝達（網路業務）、博通、Innolight及Arista Networks預計將位居超大規模雲端相關網路設備營收前列。
設計軟體層面，超大規模雲端服務商持續加大客製化晶片投入，為Synopsys和Cadence帶來增量機會，尤其是Synopsys新推出的應用最佳化IP（AOIP）模式，透過產品量產後的權利金，讓營收與晶片出貨量更直接掛鉤。
資料中心建設引發的電力需求，正成為工業及電力設備商的重要成長引擎。摩根士丹利指出，AI資本開支對工業板塊的傳導路徑，主要集中在電力供應與冷卻設備。
電力設備方面，GE Vernova的燃氣渦輪機訂單已排滿至2029年，售價從2020年代初期的每千瓦1,000美元漲至目前的每千瓦3,000美元，資料中心相關訂單已占其訂單儲備的約三分之一。INIO與BE則分別受益於高速往復式引擎及燃料電池需求。摩根士丹利認為，上調資本開支預測將進一步延長電力設備原廠（OEM）的訂單積壓時間，並提升利潤率。
隨著資本開支持續擴張，自由現金流缺口正在擴大。摩根士丹利估計，2027年將是預測期間現金流赤字最大的一年。超大規模雲端服務商今年以來已發行約2,550億美元無擔保債券，約占全年預估資本開支的30%，但10年期債券的全價收益率較2025年底上升約100至180個基點。
摩根士丹利將融資主體分為兩個層次：高評級超大規模雲端服務商（亞馬遜、Meta、Google、微軟）目前的利息保障倍數約為30.7倍，即使2027年新增發債4,000億美元，保障倍數仍可維持在11.9倍，對融資成本基本不敏感；而低評級主體（甲骨文、SPCX）的保障倍數僅約4倍，若同期新增發債1,200億美元，保障倍數將降至約1.8倍，面臨較大的融資限制。
新興雲端服務商主要依賴專案層級融資及可轉換公司債，是對融資成本最敏感的群體，通常需要借助高評級交易對手的信用支持來取得融資。
從融資結構演變來看，摩根士丹利預計2027年發債期限將偏向短期。由於晶片和伺服器產生現金流的速度較快，更適合透過資產支持融資及私募方式籌資，也能更靈活地配合合約需求。
paras_en: When the traditional definition of capital spending no longer captures the full picture, leasing finance is quietly reshaping the overall view of AI infrastructure investment. Morgan Stanley’s Nicholas Lentini team’s latest research report finds that after adding leasing capital spending, the total AI compute investment by hyperscalers and neocloud providers in 2027 rises to about $1.58 trillion, roughly 14% larger than the cash‑only measure. The figure implies an incremental AI investment of about $700 billion between 2026 and 2027, a growth rate of roughly 60%.

Morgan Stanley notes that the $1.58 trillion of capital spending will directly drive about 5% of S&P 500 revenue in 2027 and contribute roughly 25% of revenue growth. More broadly, the “Enablers” and “Adopters” that Morgan Stanley classifies as core AI beneficiaries together will drive 78% of S&P 500 profit growth in 2027. Notably, Nvidia alone is expected to capture about two‑thirds of the AI capital spending flowing into the index.

The research shows that hyperscalers have disclosed more than $1.1 trillion of leasing commitments that have not yet been activated. Because data‑center leasing is a debt‑financed asset purchase, it does not appear as capital expenditure on the cash‑flow statement and is omitted from management guidance, leading the market to long‑term underestimate the true scale of AI investment. After including leasing, Morgan Stanley estimates total AI capital spending of roughly $980 billion in 2026, $1.58 trillion in 2027 and $1.81 trillion in 2028, with year‑over‑year growth of about 100%, 60% and 14% respectively.

In this report Morgan Stanley introduces, for the first time, a systematic forecast of leasing capital spending by hyperscalers. It estimates leasing spend of $195 billion in 2027, expanding to $246 billion in 2028. By company, Oracle tops the 2027 list with $57.2 billion, followed by Microsoft ($45.3 billion), Meta ($37.2 billion), Amazon ($28.4 billion) and Google ($26.6 billion).

The core issue is accounting treatment. Hyperscalers obtain data‑center capacity through leases, which in economic substance is equivalent to debt‑financed asset purchases, yet these leases are not recorded as capital expenditures on the cash‑flow statement nor included in management’s capex guidance. Morgan Stanley argues this makes traditional capex forecasts increasingly unable to capture the full picture of capital投入.

From an investment‑return perspective Morgan Stanley is upbeat on this pool of spending. The report estimates the return on invested capital (ROIC) for new compute capacity between 25% and 50%, and evaluates two business models – GPU leasing (IaaS) and model‑API services. The former can deliver 60%‑70% marginal EBIT margins and 25%‑40% ROIC; the latter can generate incremental EBIT margins above 70% with ROIC up to 63%.

Morgan Stanley tracks the $1.58 trillion of capex down to roughly 50 companies across technology, communications services, industrials, energy and overseas ODM sectors. It calculates that about 65% of AI capex ultimately flows into revenue of S&P 500 constituents, with Nvidia accounting for roughly two‑thirds of that inflow.
Among beneficiary segments, AI chips, memory, networking equipment and ODMs capture the largest market share, dominated by Nvidia, Samsung, SK hynix and Micron.

On the chip side Morgan Stanley sees Nvidia offering the best risk‑adjusted return, citing its early‑stage growth in a new‑generation product cycle, the Feynman platform’s potential to drive over $50 billion of revenue per GW of compute, and a valuation of about 15 times FY28 EPS, leaving room for multiple expansion. Broadcom also benefits from custom‑chip business growth, with the XPU market expected to exceed $1 trillion by 2028.

On memory, DRAM has become a key bottleneck for AI builds, yet related stocks trade at only about a 3‑times forward 12‑month P/E, implying virtually no growth premium. Morgan Stanley judges the memory cycle will enter its later stage in Q4 2026, with price gains moderating and supply growth capping profit upside. SK hynix and Samsung have locked most demand via long‑term agreements; SK hynix pledged to repurchase and cancel 40 billion won of shares, while Samsung set a shareholder‑return target of 900 billion‑1.1 trillion won for 2026.

In networking equipment, each additional dollar of hyperscaler capex translates to roughly $0.25 of networking‑equipment revenue, putting total networking revenue at about $374 billion in 2027. Leading companies in this space include Nvidia (networking business), Broadcom, Innolight and Arista Networks, which are expected to rank among the top earners from hyperscaler‑related networking spend.

On design‑software, hyperscalers’ continued push into custom chips creates incremental opportunities for Synopsys and Cadence, especially as Synopsys rolls out an Application‑Optimized IP (AOIP) model that ties royalties to chip shipments, linking revenue more directly to volume.

The power demand generated by data‑center construction is becoming a major growth engine for industrial and power‑equipment firms. Morgan Stanley notes that the transmission of AI capex to the industrial sector is focused on power‑supply and cooling equipment.

In power equipment, GE Vernova’s gas‑turbine orders are booked through 2029, with unit prices rising from about $1,000 per kilowatt in the early 2020s to roughly $3,000 today, and data‑center orders now represent about one‑third of its order backlog. INIO and BE benefit from high‑speed reciprocating engines and fuel‑cell demand respectively. Morgan Stanley says the upward revision of capex forecasts will further extend OEM order‑backlog periods and lift profit margins.

As capex continues to expand, the free‑cash‑flow gap widens. Morgan Stanley estimates 2027 will see the largest cash‑flow deficit in the forecast horizon. Hyperscalers have issued roughly $255 billion of unsecured debt this year, about 30% of projected annual capex, while 10‑year bond yields have risen by roughly 100‑180 basis points since the end of 2025.

Morgan Stanley splits financing entities into two tiers: high‑grade hyperscalers (Amazon, Meta, Google, Microsoft) with an interest‑coverage ratio of about 30.7×; even with $400 billion of new debt in 2027 the ratio would stay near 11.9×, making financing costs largely insensitive. Lower‑grade entities (Oracle, SPCX) have a coverage ratio of only about 4×, which would fall to roughly 1.8× if they added $120 billion of debt in the same period, exposing them to tighter financing constraints.

Emerging cloud providers rely mainly on project‑level financing and convertible bonds, making them the most cost‑sensitive group, often needing credit support from high‑grade counterparties to obtain funding.

Looking at financing‑structure evolution, Morgan Stanley expects 2027 debt issuances to skew short‑term. Because chips and servers generate cash flow quickly, they are better suited to asset‑backed financing and private placements, offering greater flexibility to match contract needs.

items.title: 《彭博》專訪龔明鑫  台灣準備對中國緊縮AI晶片出口管制
items.title_en: Bloomberg Interview with Gong Ming‑Xin: Taiwan Prepares to Tighten AI Chip Export Controls to China
paras: 經濟部長龔明鑫接受《彭博》專訪表示，台灣正準備加強人工智慧 (AI) 伺服器與先進半導體出口管制，進一步與美國限制措施接軌。新制生效後，未經許可將受管制產品運往中國，將依《貿易法》追究刑責，但目前尚未公布實施時程。
《彭博》週五 (16 日) 報導，龔明鑫在 10 月 12 日的訪談中指出，台灣擬將 AI 伺服器及先進半導體納入出口管制清單。他表示，台灣在《台美對等貿易協定》(ART) 中做出多項承諾，未來部分管制品項的措施將與美國相互對應。
此次規劃的重點，是擴大 AI 伺服器與先進半導體的出口管制範圍。現行《貿易法》已對部分戰略性高科技貨品的違規輸出訂有刑責，但個別 AI 硬體是否受管制，仍須依產品規格、交易對象與用途等條件判斷。新措施的具體品項及實施方式，仍待政府公布。
美國近年持續限制輝達 (NVDA-US)、超微 (AMD-US) 等業者的先進 AI 晶片出口至中國，但中國企業仍透過轉運與黑市取得相關硬體。台灣擬收緊管制，也使其在美方防堵晶片走私的行動中，扮演更積極角色。
除了出口管制，龔明鑫也在專訪中揭露赴美供應鏈布局，表示台灣規劃在美國推動不只一座工業園區，每座開發成本約 20 億至 40 億美元，首站將從德州開始，協助台灣中小型供應商赴美設立據點。
園區主要服務對象，是支援台積電 (2330-TW、TSM-US)、鴻海 (2317-TW) 等大廠的供應商。相較於具備資金與規模優勢的大型企業，中小型業者自行赴美設廠的門檻較高，透過園區集中布局，可協助其銜接當地 AI 硬體製造需求。
經濟部週五進一步說明，園區將採取「民間出資、政府協助」模式，並與台灣區電機電子工業同業公會合作推動。政府將提供貸款保證，協助業者與美國聯邦及地方政府溝通簽證、土地等需求，因此每座園區最高 40 億美元的開發成本，並非全數由政府編列預算支應。
龔明鑫表示，目標是在美國建立長期、可持續發展的供應鏈，讓台灣企業、美國企業與當地勞工共同參與。《彭博》引述知情人士指出，台灣已在德州取得一塊園區用地；經濟部對此表示，將在適當時機進一步說明。
從加強敏感科技出口管理，到協助供應商赴美布局，兩項規劃反映台灣正擴大與美國在半導體及 AI 產業的合作。不過，出口管制的具體範圍與生效日期，以及赴美園區的開發進度，仍待後續公布。

paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑Xin told Bloomberg that Taiwan is preparing to strengthen export controls on AI servers and advanced semiconductors, aligning further with U.S. restrictions. After the new rules take effect, any unlicensed shipments of controlled products to China will be prosecuted under the Trade Act, though the implementation timetable has not yet been announced.

Bloomberg reported on Friday the 16th that in an interview on Oct. 12, Gong said Taiwan plans to place AI servers and advanced semiconductors on its export‑control list. He noted that Taiwan has made several commitments under the Taiwan‑U.S. Reciprocal Trade Agreement (ART) and that future controls on certain items will be coordinated with the United States.

The focus of the plan is to broaden the scope of export controls for AI servers and advanced semiconductors. The current Trade Act already imposes criminal penalties for illegal export of certain strategic high‑tech goods, but whether specific AI hardware is controlled will depend on product specifications, the buyer and the intended use. The exact items and implementation methods of the new measures are still pending government release.

The United States has recently continued to restrict advanced AI chips from companies such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) from reaching China, yet Chinese firms still obtain the hardware through transshipment and black‑market channels. Taiwan’s tighter controls would make it play a more active role in U.S. efforts to curb chip smuggling.

In addition to export controls, Gong revealed in the interview that Taiwan is planning multiple industrial parks in the United States, each costing roughly $2‑4 billion to develop, with the first site to be built in Texas to help Taiwanese SMEs establish a foothold in the U.S. market.

The parks will primarily serve suppliers to major firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) and Foxconn (2317‑TW). Compared with large corporations that have ample capital and scale, SMEs face high barriers to setting up factories in the U.S.; a clustered park approach can help them meet local AI‑hardware manufacturing demand.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs explained on Friday that the parks will follow a “private‑capital, government‑assistance” model and will be promoted in partnership with the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Industries Association. The government will provide loan guarantees and help companies coordinate visas, land and other requirements with federal and local authorities, so the up‑to‑$4 billion development cost per park will not be fully funded by the state budget.

Gong said the goal is to build a long‑term, sustainable supply chain in the United States that involves Taiwanese firms, U.S. companies and local workers. Bloomberg cited sources saying Taiwan has already secured a site in Texas, and the ministry said it will provide further details at the appropriate time.

From tightening controls on sensitive technology exports to assisting suppliers’ U.S. expansion, the two initiatives show Taiwan is deepening its semiconductor and AI cooperation with the United States. However, the precise scope and effective date of the export controls, as well as the development timeline for the U.S. parks, remain to be announced.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> US Dollar Records First Weekly Decline in Over a Month as Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool and AI Concerns Persist
paras: 美元周五(16日)走低，兌歐元與日元均創下逾1個月來首見單週貶值，反映市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期降溫，以及投資人對AI引發股市賣壓的疑慮持續存在。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.17%，報101.87，本週下跌約0.35%。
本週公布的消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，一度令市場感到不安。不過，聯準會官員的談話顯示，目前沒有急於進一步緊縮貨幣政策的必要，有助於穩定美國公債殖利率，也削弱了美元的支撐力道。
AI類股本週大幅下跌，壓力也蔓延至部分信用市場。由於投資人已大量押注AI供應鏈各個環節，如今開始擔心資料中心營運商可能無法及時實現獲利，進而償還債務。
StoneX全球市場研究主管Matt Weller表示，「我認為今天乃至本週最值得關注的現象，是美元與AI交易之間的緊密連動。通常科技股遭到拋售時，市場會預期美元因避險需求而走強。我們確實看到部分資金流向債券，但美元實際上卻在下跌。」
本週英鎊與瑞士法郎兌美元的升幅居前。瑞士法郎受到避險需求支撐，市場也預期，即使利率環境進一步走低，瑞士仍不太可能將政策利率降至目前零利率以下。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.31%，至1英鎊兌1.3314美元，本週累計上漲0.63%。
美元兌瑞士法郎則下跌0.25%，至0.8246瑞郎，本週累計下跌0.67%。瑞郎在過去兩個交易日累計升值逾1.4%。
芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金（IMF）與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。
紐約梅隆銀行宏觀經濟策略師John Velis表示，「我認為，目前聯準會決策委員會內部，尤其是理事們，尚未形成足夠共識支持10月升息。不過，12月是否升息仍是未解之題，從現在到那時還有許多事情可能發生。」
歐元區財政風險仍受關注
法國財政風險仍是市場關注的背景因素。10月初，法國債務風險溢價曾大幅攀升。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1歐元兌1.1227美元。歐元週四已上漲0.56%，創下兩個月來最大單日漲幅，全週上漲約0.23%。
投資人預期，美國總統川普將避免讓中東或烏克蘭局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能推升通膨，進而損害他在期中選舉前的政治支持度。
美元兌日元下跌0.08%，至158.11日元。日元終止連續四週貶值走勢，本週升值0.13%。此前，伊朗衝突支撐美元走強。
近期油價上漲推升美元，同時對歐元與日元等能源進口國貨幣造成壓力。
日本銀行（BOJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)週五再次強調，潛在通膨率可能超越央行設定的2%目標，仍是需要留意的風險。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 16th), with both the euro and the yen posting their first weekly depreciation in more than a month, reflecting a cooling of market expectations for further Fed rate hikes and lingering investor worries that AI is weighing on equity markets.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.17% to 101.87, down about 0.35% for the week.

Consumer price and producer price data released this week came in above expectations, briefly unsettling markets. However, comments from Fed officials indicated no urgent need for further monetary tightening, helping to stabilise US Treasury yields and weakening support for the dollar.

AI‑related stocks fell sharply this week, and the pressure spread to parts of the credit market. Investors, who have heavily bet on every link of the AI supply chain, are now worried that data‑center operators may not generate profits quickly enough to service their debt.

Matt Weller, head of global market research at StoneX, said, "I think the most noteworthy phenomenon today and this week is the tight link between the dollar and AI trading. Usually when tech stocks are sold off, the market expects the dollar to strengthen on safe‑haven demand. We did see some flows into bonds, but the dollar actually fell."

The pound and the Swiss franc posted the biggest gains against the dollar this week. The franc was supported by safe‑haven demand, and markets expect that even if rates fall further, Switzerland is unlikely to push its policy rate below the current zero‑percent level.
The pound rose 0.31% to $1.3314, up 0.63% for the week.
The dollar slipped 0.25% against the Swiss franc to 0.8246 CHF, down 0.67% for the week. The franc had appreciated more than 1.4% over the past two trading days.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows the market now assigns an 83% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 49% a month ago.

However, whether there will be a hike in December remains an open question, and many things could happen between now and then."

The euro rose 0.08% to $1.1227. It had gained 0.56% on Thursday, the biggest single‑day rise in two months, and is up about 0.23% for the week.

Investors expect that President Trump will try to avoid further escalation in the Middle East or Ukraine, as a larger conflict could push inflation higher and damage his political support ahead of the mid‑term elections.
